entities.name: AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE
entities.description: Message sent by UE containing authentication response parameters.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION FAILURE
entities.description: Message sent by UE indicating authentication failure.

entities.name: AUTHENTICATION REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by network to initiate authentication procedure.

entities.name: RES* correctness check
entities.description: Network verifies the correctness of RES* parameter from authentication response.

entities.name: ngKSI stored in 5G NAS security context
entities.description: Condition where ngKSI is already stored in the network's 5G NAS security context.

entities.name: 5GMM cause #21 synch failure
entities.description: Authentication failure due to synchronization failure.

entities.name: Different ngKSI value included
entities.description: Network includes a different ngKSI value in new authentication requests when ngKSI is already stored.

entities.name: Renegotiate authentication parameters
entities.description: Network may renegotiate with UDM/AUSF to provide new authentication parameters upon synchronization failure.

relations.description: Network stops timer T3560 upon receipt of AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message.
AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message triggers RES* correctness check.
Condition of ngKSI being stored establishes the requirement to include different ngKSI in new authentication requests.
Network stops timer T3560 upon receipt of AUTHENTICATION FAILURE message.
Synchronization failure condition establishes possibility for network to renegotiate authentication parameters.
